prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive desktop control showcase layout: Redesign home_intro into a split layout that visually demonstrates how to trigger, hide, and speak to the desktop pet. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pre-adoption custom pet style selection flow: Insert a new style customization screen before pick_friend allowing users to select visual art themes before choosing or creating a pet. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned custom pet rendering issues and aesthetic mismatch during creation.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Onboarding path decision story reel redesign: Redesign the story intro screen into an engaging carousel format with dynamic mascot media showcasing desktop pet interactions. (why: The choose_path mean time is very high (514s), suggesting users get distracted or lack clear context early on.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account pet sync and recovery banner: Add a highlighted sync badge on the sign_in screen clarifying that existing pets and profiles are automatically synced upon logging in. (why: The top support theme with 8 emails involved missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet generation waiting estimated time callout: Enable explicit time estimates and active progress indicators on the waiting screen while background assets render. (why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off and support questions about stuck rendering.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop hide and summon quick tips component: Display a quick key shortcut callout on the home_intro screen explaining how to hide and reveal the desktop pet instantly. (why: Multiple users wrote support asking how to manage, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
6: [adoption, hint] Custom pet photo validation hint: Add inline photo requirement guidelines on upload_photos specifying lighting and framing details for accurate pet generation. (why: Support logs indicate users experienced failures or visual errors when creating custom pets from uploaded photos.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet interaction safety info screen: Add a dedicated pre-finish screen (new_pet_controls) detailing screen overlay settings and sound controls before landing on home_intro. (why: Support reported issue themes around pet not displaying on desktop and desktop features misbehaving post-setup.)
